### Description

Short summary of what changed, why it's needed, and any important implementation notes.

### Related issues

Link related issues. If this PR fixes an issue, mention it like: Fixes #123.

### Testing

List the checks you ran, e.g. `bun run lint`, `bun run check-types`, `bun run build`,
`bun run format:check`, plus any manual testing.

For UI changes, note how the change was verified in the browser (routes touched, flows
exercised: sign-in, sign-up, dashboard, protected routes). Align visual changes with the
design direction in [design.md](../design.md).

### Screenshot/Recording (if applicable)

Attach a screenshot, GIF, or recording of the change. Optional, but helps reviewers
understand UI or workflow changes.

<details>
<summary>Checklist</summary>

- [ ] I kept this PR small and focused
- [ ] I ran a self-review before opening this PR
- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks or explained why not
- [ ] I updated docs when behavior or setup changed
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behavior changed, or explained why not
- [ ] I only added comments where the logic is not obvious

</details>
